messages:
Noah: heads-up — promote is failing at artifact-verify with checksum mismatch on a multipart upload chunk. Change window opens in 30m and we have a downstream marketing push.
Priya: ugh. which artifact?
Noah: bundle artifact sha256:df00... failing with expected-etag != computed-etag. deploybot logs: 
```
2026-03-25T14:12:03Z upload part 3 id=sha256:df00... etag=\"a1b2c3\"
2026-03-25T14:12:04Z manifest compute-etag=\"a1b2c3\"
2026-03-25T14:12:05Z verify: computed-etag != registry-etag for sha256:df00... expected=\"a1b2c3\" got=\"ff00ee\"
2026-03-25T14:12:05Z deploybot: verify failed, aborting promotion
```
Jules: could be a partial reupload that took an alternate mirror. We saw similar when a runner retried part upload and wrote to a stale shard.
infra-bot: registry reports multipart reassemble checksum mismatch for object df00...; last write at 2026-03-25T14:11:58Z by runner-21.
Priya: options: (A) pin to previous image (sha256:9988) and force-promote, (B) rebuild artifact from HEAD and re-run full verify (takes ~25m), (C) attempt a targeted reupload of part 3 from runner-21 (risky).
Noah: change window closes in ~30m, so rebuild might just squeeze in if we parallelize jobs. But rebuild + full integration smoke is ~25m, plus deployment steps.
Jules: small bugfix in this commit is non-critical. Pin would preserve window and marketing cadence. Rebuild gives correctness but risks missing window.
ci-bot: quick check: sha256:9988 passed current matrix earlier; no regressions. smoke green.
Priya: if we pin, we must note the rollback and schedule a targeted re-deploy with rebuilt artifact ASAP after window. Also add an infra action to detect multipart-stale-writes.
Noah: what's the risk of client-facing flakiness if we promote 9988? minimal. The failing checksum seems limited to the multipart path.
Jules: if we try targeted reupload (C), need runner-21 logs to verify part payload; might be faster but higher fragility.
Priya: vote: pin and follow up with rebuild+verify tomorrow morning. We preserve SLAs.
Noah: +1. I'll run manual promote to sha256:9988 in 90s unless objections.
Jules: +1 with caveat to include release note about artefact integrity check.
Noah: executing: /promote --image sha256:9988 --by noah --reason "checksum mismatch on multipart upload; pin to last-good to preserve window"
deploybot: promote request accepted. skipping prefetch. verify queued on runner-5.
deploybot: verify passed on runner-5 id=sha256:9988. rollout proceeding to 10% then 100%.
deploybot: rollout complete. Release window preserved.
Noah: release notes draft: "Pinned to last-known-good image due to multipart upload checksum mismatch during artifact verify. Follow-ups: ARTIFACT-1204 (investigate multipart reassemble checksum mismatches), INFRA-1205 (runner retry idempotency fix), RELEASE-709 (rebuild & redeploy after window)."
Priya: creating ARTIFACT-1204 and INFRA-1205 now; tagging with logs from registry and runner-21.
Jules: also adding a monitoring alert: registry multipart checksum mismatch > 0 triggers paging.
infra-bot: ticket ARTIFACT-1204 created and linked to this thread.
Noah: thanks team. closing thread.
